items.name: A pocket-sized coding project
items.description: The Raspberry Pi Pico W is a small Wi-Fi microcontroller. Give it to a tinkerer with a challenge: blink the onboard LED in Morse code. A USB data cable is needed.
items.origin: Canadian retailer. Raspberry Pi designed the board in the UK.
